title: LA Colossal – Cloisonné 05 (Seated)
prompt:
Fine art body painting photography. Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Korean woman in her late 40s, black hair in a low chignon with a gold pin, natural face with a gentle smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips filling the armchair, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body cloisonné enamel body painting in jingtailan style, from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, no collar band. The body painting is the only covering on the body — no garments, no fabric, no robes, no bodysuit, no leggings, no stockings. Glossy turquoise enamel base with raised gold wire cells filled with peonies, magpies, and plum branches. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Seated in a rosewood armchair, torso turned open toward the camera, one forearm on the armrest, the other hand on her thigh, legs crossed at the knee. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch turquoise enamel platform stiletto sandals with gold spiral straps coiling up the calf.
Nails: Extra long coffin nails, turquoise with gold.

Background & Lighting: Ming scholar's study with rosewood furniture and scroll paintings, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm window light with raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
